notes: PARTIAL TALENT DATA: all six Icy Veins leveling pages were retrieved as static text, but Cloudflare blocked the browser and raw HTML/JavaScript. All level-10-through-60 picks remain "*"; no static talent milestone or prerequisite was promoted into an exact per-level order. These are source placeholders, not usable completed builds.

Priority/importance scores are editorial, not source measurements. H means ID, level and acquisition have strong retrieved support; M marks a source conflict or secondary race-token evidence. No entries were tested in the live client.

Every listed spell ID has a fetched Icy Veins Forever record. Verified higher ranks are alternatives in the first-unlock milestone; Shank also has a level-44 upgrade reminder. Factual provenance is in hunter_rogue_evidence.json.

Human Hunter: Josephine Carson gives the Elwynn taming trials, ending with quest 94864. Training the Beast 94793 sends the player to Isaac Chan in Goldshire. Its reward is labelled Training Lesson; the completion text explicitly mentions feeding, revival and pet training.[74][76]
Dwarf Hunter: Grif Wildheart in Kharanos ends the taming trials with quest 6085. Training the Beast 6086 sends the player to Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.[83][87]

Night Elf Hunter: Dazalar in Dolanaar ends the taming trials with quest 6102. Training the Beast 6103 sends the player to Jocaste in Darnassus. The database final objective says Strigid Screecher, whereas the class guide says Forest Owl; no beast-name assumption is embedded in the milestone.[85][89][9]
Orc/Troll Hunter: Thotar in Razor Hill ends the taming trials with quest 6082. Training the Beast 6081 sends the player to Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.[82][86]
Tauren Hunter: Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village ends the taming trials with quest 6088. Training the Beast 6089 sends the player to Holt Thunderhorn in Thunder Bluff.[84][88]

Skyborne Hunter: Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar ends the taming trials with quest 94013. Training the Beast 94050 sends the player to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar and rewards Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet.[73][75]
Tame Beast, Call Pet and Dismiss Pet come from the taming trials. Feed Pet, Revive Pet and Beast Training need the subsequent Training the Beast step; the steps must not be conflated.[11][15][94]
Human Hunter and both-faction Skyborne Hunter/Rogue combinations are documented in the Forever race guides.[90][109]

The raceFile token Skyborne comes from a third-party recorded UnitRace mapping (Windshaper ID 96; an Alliance ID-95 record is discussed), not an in-game test in this task. The Skyborne milestone is M confidence: verify the token for both factions before shipping. Undead uses Scourge, not Undead.[115]

Skyborne Rogue introduction: At Home in the Shadows (92483) starts at Rorian the Dayseeker and sends the player to Akeri Duskblade in the Thendal Grove watchtower. It has no listed spell/equipment reward, so it is not a spell milestone or a raceOnlyQuests entry. A Skyborne level-10 Blade of Cunning reward chain was not verified.[107]

Poisons 2842 unlocks at 20. Alliance uses Mathias Shaw and Agent Kearnen; Horde uses Shenthul, Taskmaster Fizzule and the Hinott's Assistance completion from Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill. Both routes need Lockpicking 75. The class-guide poison section nesting under Undead is not a race restriction.[10][92][93]

Pick Lock is level 16/trainer with M confidence: the Forever ability list and dedicated Lockpicking guide agree, while Icy Veins tables say level 15 Lockpicking Class Quest. Check the actual trainer before making this alert strict.[100][104][6]
Aimed Shot is baseline for all Hunter specs at 20, spell 19434. The level-60 guide hyperlink 20904 is rank 6, not the unlock spell.[21][22][91]

Trueshot Aura is a Marksmanship talent, not a trainer/quest unlock. Spell 1299346 is the level-25 rank-1 record; 19506 is the level-40 rank-3 record. It is excluded from spellMilestones because kind has no talent option and its allocation level was not recovered.[103][23]
Shank first unlocks at 24 as 1329283; 1329549 is the level-44 rank. Icy Veins links the latter from its level-24 discussion, so that link cannot serve as the first-rank ID.[105][29][8]

Riposte 14251 is verified as the Rogue reactive talent. It is omitted from procSpells because a Forever activation-window duration was not verified. The database's 6 seconds is cooldown/disarm, not a proven reaction window.[12][6]

PROVISIONAL PROC SCOPE: Mongoose Bite rank entries use 10 seconds because Expose Prey buff 1310726 has a verified 10-second duration. This confirms the talent-triggered activation, not every natural-dodge activation. Validate/gate native-dodge timing before enabling strict missed-proc findings.[95][106]

Mongoose Bite rank IDs 1495, 14269 and 14270 are verified separately, with first-rank training at 16. Pet-only Growl/Bite/Claw are not player-spell milestones; they require pet-spellbook handling.[13][126][127]
Mongoose Bite rank 4 is 14271, requiring level 58.[128]

Equipment filters use the actual Blade of Cunning reward quests, not breadcrumbs: Snatch and Grab 2206 (Human), Onin's Report 2239 (Dwarf/Gnome), Destiny Calls 2242 (NightElf), The Deathstalkers 1978 (Scourge), The Shattered Hand 1858 (Orc/Troll). The class guide and item reward list support these; treat the first three race locks as M until quest eligibility is checked.[10][72]

Wowhead Forever explicitly confirms Undead for The Deathstalkers 1978 and Orc/Troll for The Shattered Hand 1858. Quest-name filters may collide with other quest stages or unrelated quests; prefer IDs if the consumer supports them.[113][114]
No Hunter level-50 quest reward is asserted: the class-quest guide says post-30 quests were not confirmed in the beta.[9]
Orders cover the ordinary level-10-through-60 schedule; no Legacy Talented bonus schedule is inferred. Do not publish wildcard-only builds as a reconstruction of the launch talent reshuffle.
